components.name: Primary button
components.css: .ds-button{background:var(--primary,oklch(0.46 0.19 260));color:var(--primary-foreground,white);border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:4px;padding:8px 12px;font:500 14px Plus Jakarta Sans,sans-serif}.ds-button:hover{opacity:.8}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ring,blue)}

components.name: Text field
components.css: .ds-label{display:grid;gap:6px;color:var(--foreground,#172033);font:500 14px Plus Jakarta Sans,sans-serif}.ds-input{border:1px solid var(--input,#ccd3dd);border-radius:4px;background:var(--background,#fff);color:var(--foreground,#172033);padding:10px}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ring,blue)}

components.name: Status badge
components.html: Pending Review
components.css: .ds-status{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;border:1px solid color-mix(in oklch,var(--warning-surface,orange) 40%,transparent);background:color-mix(in oklch,var(--warning-surface,orange) 12%,transparent);color:var(--warning,#8b5b00);border-radius:9999px;padding:2px 8px;font:500 12px Plus Jakarta Sans,sans-serif}

narrative.overview: Canon is a restrained institutional workspace: clear hierarchy, aligned data, and familiar controls support quick, accountable work. Cobalt accents and a slate navigation rail establish identity without decorative gradients or glass effects.
dos: Keep pending and credited hours distinct, and use the product's established status vocabulary.
Give each icon-only action an accessible name and each interactive element a visible focus state.
Keep dense operational screens scannable on both desktop and mobile.
donts: Avoid decorative gradients, glassmorphism, and reliance on color alone.
